pair_texts.sic: A man with a full head of hair and wearing a backpack, shirt, black slacks and dress shoes is walking out of "New York Dolls Gentlemen's Club."
pair_texts.non: There is a bald man walking out of the "New York Dolls Gentlemen's Club."

pair_texts.sic: A person with hat, long shirt, and jeans is standing in a stand of trees with no underbrush, bent over and examining the base of a tree, while a footpath crosses the bottom of the image.
pair_texts.non: The man in jeans and a hat is standing on the path looking at the trees.

pair_texts.sic: One man wearing glasses sits in front of an Apple computer and drinks from a cup while another man wearing a cap and glasses stands in front of a microphone.
pair_texts.non: the men are sitting in front of an apple computer with capes on

pair_texts.sic: One male in a blue sports uniform is kicking the soccer ball while a second man in a white sports uniform is trying to kick the ball out of the way.
pair_texts.non: One male in a blue sports drink is kicking the soccer ball

pair_texts.sic: Two Asian men are passing each other and one is carrying a huge bunch of green onions while the other watches and there is a small child in the background.
pair_texts.non: A child is carrying green onions for the men.

pair_texts.sic: Two men, both wearing hats, are attaching a red threshing machine to a pair of horses who are facing to the left, while they are all in a dirt field.
pair_texts.non: Two men are riding horses through a large field of grass.

pair_texts.sic: Two Middle Eastern men are in a kitchen while one is shirtless with a chest full of hair and a mustache is preparing fish and the other in a white shirt is peering at the camera.
pair_texts.non: Middle Eastern men are preparing pasta for dinner while staring at a camera.

pair_texts.sic: A man squatting in the foreground of a photograph while taking a photograph of his own of a man doing a skateboarding kick flip in midair above a short flight of stairs outdoors.
pair_texts.non: A man is taking the picture of a skateboarder who is being taken by aliens.

pair_texts.sic: A young man in a gray tee-shirt and gray sweatpants stands by a metal tiered shelf in an industrial kitchen, holding the top edge of the metal structure, with one leg resting on the knee of the other leg.
pair_texts.non: A man in all black stands in an industrial kitchen.

pair_texts.sic: Two adults, one female in white, with shades and one male, gray clothes, walking across a street, away from a eatery with a blurred image of a dark colored red shirted person in the foreground.
pair_texts.non: Two adults run across the street to get away from a red shirted person chasing them.

pair_texts.sic: A dark-haired man in blue jeans and a light green polo is standing next to a man with khaki cargo shorts and a blue polo as they pose for a picture with locals in a foreign land.
pair_texts.non: A dark-haired man in a dress is taking pictures of the man in green cargo shorts.

pair_texts.sic: A child wearing a blue short-sleeve plaid shirt and brown cargo shorts is squeezing the face of a man wearing a gray hat, blue jeans, and a blue t-shirt.
pair_texts.non: A man in a blue outfit and gray cap carries a sleeping newborn wearing shorts and a flat blue shirt.

pair_texts.sic: This is a closeup of a young, innocent-looking boy with tousled hair who is holding with both hands what seems to be a plastic, green and orange beach ball with a butterfly design as the sun shines upon him from his right.
pair_texts.non: A boy is holding a blue and red beach ball.

pair_texts.sic: A group of boys wearing orange jerseys playing soccer, with a blond boy guarding a dark-haired boy working the soccer ball down the field, while the other boys are running in the background.
pair_texts.non: There is a group of boys wearing orange jerseys playing basketball.

pair_texts.sic: Two young men dressed in summer clothing of shorts and tank tops stand in front of a matching pair of pseudo rickshaws for transportation as men cycle in the background.
pair_texts.non: Two men are riding rickshaws without any clothes on.

pair_texts.sic: A young boy wearing a red shirt with yellow writing on it and a red sports cap is squatted in shallow water and touching a yellow pail filled with sand.
pair_texts.non: The little kid with a red shirt and yellow letters, stood on a foot stool to reach both his hands into the dirty water in the sink.

pair_texts.sic: One black man and one caucasian man are at the front of the pack of otherwise predominantly Asian track runners; all wearing shorts, running shoes and numbered paper race-bibs.
pair_texts.non: The black man and caucasian man are in front of a group of horses.

pair_texts.sic: In front of a Penney's store, a metal sculpture depicts a man dressed in a suit and top hat holding broom and pushing a wheelbarrow containing a suitcase, a bucket, and another object.
pair_texts.non: A sculpture outside of a retail store is of a man in a basketball outfit.

pair_texts.sic: A woman in a purple sweater stands with her arms folded beside several pieces of luggage while two other women stand beside her, looking in her direction.
pair_texts.non: There is a woman sitting next to several pieces of luggage.

pair_texts.sic: A black teenager sitting on a blue bike is at the top of a BMX ramp observing another youth, in a red shirt, who is sailing into the air with a bike, single-handed, while performing a stunt, presumably from the ramps.
pair_texts.non: A black teenager standing on a trampoline.

pair_texts.sic: A portly man in an orange jumpsuit standing next to a woman in gray on the highway with a motorcycle laying on its side in the middle of the highway.
pair_texts.non: A man and woman riding a motorcycle.

pair_texts.sic: High in the bleachers view looking down at part of a soccer field partly obstructed by an individual in an orange wig and shirt and another spectator blowing a horn.
pair_texts.non: Spectators blow a horn at a baseball game.

pair_texts.sic: 1 little boy wearing a pirate costume following closely behind a little girl wearing a blue dress carrying a orange pumpkin bucket and walking down the sidewalk.
pair_texts.non: A boy in a clown costume followed by a girl.

pair_texts.sic: Two men in a street where 1 is pushing his bike and carrying something in his other hand looking towards the other man as he is saying something.
pair_texts.non: Three men ride their bikes to work.

pair_texts.sic: A girl, perhaps around five, wearing white shorts, red and white top and carrying a red balloon, is standing outside of a wooden building, looking inside.
pair_texts.non: The girl is inside the building, looking out.

pair_texts.sic: A female athlete in a purple sleeveless athletic bodysuit is jumping in the air from a track onto dirt while spectators watch her to her right.
pair_texts.non: a naked female athlete is standing there doing nothing.

pair_texts.sic: Two young men, one standing before a microphone and one sitting and drinking from a cup, are on stage, along with two paintings, a white screen, a lamp, and an Apple laptop.
pair_texts.non: Two men cleaning up a stage.

pair_texts.sic: A group of young high school or college students are smiling while performing a science experiment involving beakers and the transfer of liquids
pair_texts.non: A group of young high school or college students are not smiling

pair_texts.sic: Three people with their backs turned toward the camera that are dressed in what appears to be Viking and Hawaiian costumes with a crowd and towers in the background.
pair_texts.non: Three people posing for the camera.

pair_texts.sic: A man in an orange shirt and a man in a white shirt are at a vegetable stand, and the man in the orange shirt gives a woman wearing red some vegetables.
pair_texts.non: Two men are eating fresh vegetables.
